description.value: Triple O's is a BC-born quick-service burger chain that grew out of the White Spot legacy, serving 100% fresh Canadian beef burgers, hand-scooped milkshakes, and Kennebec fries sourced from Delta, BC. This location is tagged in OSM as operating 24/7 and includes a drive-through. With over 70 locations across BC, Alberta, Ontario, and Asia, it is one of the province's most widely distributed burger chains.
